(np.array([0,1,2])[0]) < pd.Series([0,1,2])

```
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# this works
pd.Series([7,8,9]) >= np.int64(8)

# this doesn't 
np.int64(8) <= pd.Series([7,8,9])
```

This happens with all numpy scalar types I tested
#### Expected Output
